Lead time 35 days after receipt of order, Net 60, valid until 13 October (18 days left from 25 September), with a re-quote right if the NdFeB magnet index moves more than 10%; the factory is closed 1-7 October. Vinh Phuc Motor Technology (quote VPM-Q-260924, 1,000 pcs, FOB Hai Phong) is 160.87 USD known landed, or 201.09 USD if ruled China origin; its origin is claimed as Vietnam with magnets from China and documentation on request, so origin is unknown until the broker rules. Its lead time is 60 days after PPAP approval (10 free samples, 4 weeks), with IATF 16949 still in progress, a 200 pc MOQ, a 30% deposit and 70% before shipment for the first three orders, and no validity date. The sender is not in the supplier master and is flagged for review, so no request goes to it.

recommendation.finding: The Yunzhan fire stops 10 open PO lines across five drive motors. Unless there is stock, that puts the Tern T2 short on three motors and the Porter P5 short on two from October. Yunzhan says recovery takes 6 to 8 weeks and has given no revised dates. My results hold no total dollar cost of the fire, so I won't state one. The four ways through are laid out below, and Dana's stock count decides most of them. The only other maker quoted for the main drive motor is Vinh Phuc Motor Technology, at $160.87 landed per piece. That is FOB Hai Phong, 1,000 pcs, with no validity date. Its lead time is 60 days after PPAP approval (10 free samples, 4 weeks), and IATF 16949 is still in progress. It has a 200 pc MOQ and wants a 30% deposit with 70% before shipment on the first three orders. It claims Vietnam origin with magnets from China, and the price becomes $201.09 if customs rules it China. Its origin is to confirm. It is not in the supplier master and is flagged for review, so no request goes to it. For comparison, Yunzhan's own quote Q-YZ-26-0831 is $188.99 landed (FOB Shenzhen, 35 days after receipt of order, Net 60, valid to 13 October) against $191.08 last paid. I found no alternative for the other four motors. The two Porter motors could not be checked and still need a separate look.
